assumptions: Shared camera allocation/contact policy (authored, uncalibrated; not catalog urgency): all scenes use T002=70, T014=70 (80 for locally believed major/destroyed damage), and established-human T027=78. A single-frame camera-candidate T027 stays <=64; person/human detections of the same locally associated candidate in >=2 distinct capture parent /image IDs from the same reporting agent promote its T027 to 81, above those surveys at a safe boundary. Raw/associated copies, duplicate boxes and replays of the same capture count once. An existing waiting proposed T027 is refreshed in-place once on promotion, without a new A050 or revision; timestamps and frame IDs are not proposal-signature changes. Camera-review T011 stays <=63. Failed candidate A009 sensor contacts suppress the same candidate or a locally recorded site within 3 m for 120 s and require camera presence evidence acquired after the failure before retry; failure does not establish human absence. These are shared defaults even without camera_search_policy; explicit existing overrides are honored, and regional search policies are unchanged. Existing commitments use authored policy fields F202/F209/F212 from 10_字段385; 05_任务96 and 14_场景任务映射 do not mandate task ordering. A coordinator-known accepted/executing commitment with a matching delivered current-task id/revision remains an allocator candidate, subject to priority, interruptibility, capability, access, payload and energy checks. Queued A052 and assignments awaiting delivery/acceptance remain reserved; unmatched current-task reports do not release them. A053 acceptance-to-deadline windows are not unconditional uninterruptible leases: replacement acceptance still waits for the real action boundary and A056 checkpoint, with A057 revalidation on resume. Equal-priority 81 contacts cannot interrupt each other. A queued camera T027 is canceled as stale through A054 only when its exact local candidate has a delivered belief.entity_ref and the referenced human needs are known without a contact need. Recheck before allocation/acceptance and before initial approach/A009, not after this task own successful contact; no distance-only identity or suppression of unassociated tracks. A059 services may preempt only a lower-priority executing preemptible ordinary commitment through the existing A053/A056 action-boundary checkpoint and A057 resume; active service scopes and real capability/access/energy/aboard constraints remain binding. Service A053 rechecks local commitments, and refusals retain busy/payload/access/energy/tool causes instead of all becoming capability failures. Fresh unassociated tracks can still starve lower-priority searches under this unchanged policy. No scene switch, truth, count, location, outcome or capability change is introduced. Survey-relative starvation is expected to be removed only when corroboration and real capability, access, energy and delivery permit; contact, rescue and fixed-horizon results are not guaranteed.

Camera re-sightings of an already contacted person (a local non-camera human with delivered contact needs) associate to that person when strict point-in-box and camera-track matches miss, using the same measured box tests: its contact foot point projected inside the box, else within the measured bottom-edge half-span around the box bottom-centre ground estimate. One-person-per-frame exclusion still applies. This prevents repeat contacts of the same known resident from minting new tracks; it never marks an uncontacted or unknown person absent and changes no truth, needs, urgency or capability.

A carrier with an unacknowledged person aboard does not accept (A053) or resume (A057) unrelated work such as contact, survey or clearance until that person is handed over; care, load, transport, handover and water-recovery tasks (T029-T036) still proceed. This applies the existing A059 service rule ("a team with a person aboard finishes that person's handover before serving anyone else") to ordinary tasks. A deferred commitment stays suspended, not failed; capacity, access, receiver and truth checks are unchanged.
v0.5 scripted sensing/network/compute and authored, uncalibrated equipment/work models; no vision backend or calibrated rescue physics.

Background support, roads/tracks, widths, accesses and reservations come from the original build inputs and selected pure geometry functions, exported by dev/export_scene_sources.py; sources/sha256 records their exact provenance. No new road, pad or off-scene continuation is invented.

Compact authored incident and deployment rules only. Seed controls sampled positions and headings. Task allowlists still require local observations, beliefs, capability checks, allocation and real action results; no rescue outcome is scripted.

Canonical grid U remains the height source. Unit model scale is retained. Scene-specific professional access limits and source surface names must survive semantic adaptation; a foot tread is not asphalt or vehicle access.

SC07 is retained because its original builder is explicitly woodland-urban interface and its core profile has fire/wind with wildland_rescue/fire roles; SC06 is urban fire and SC17 is the industrial incident.

One intact, empty interface building is the authored fire focus. Only hazard-1 footprint is anchored to that actual sampled building; the SC07 fire intensity, wind, smoke and 300 s fire_spread event remain profile-driven.

The fire truck starts off-road 16–26 m from the sampled building model origin. This is not distance to the nearest burning footprint point. A062 applies the produced 8.23 m hose reach to the actual hazard footprint and requires a reachable exterior stand whenever the current pose is out of range. The portable pump keeps its independent 7.24 m hose reach; no inherited 50 m reach is used.

Truck and portable kit each start with six authored abstract consumable units, independently accounted; supply-1 has twelve actual water stock units. These are not litres or a claim that the truck's 2000 L geometric design assumption is usable inventory. T094 must transfer real stock before further suppression.

Placement reserves the BASE/DEPLOYED shared-origin envelope including the hose, not only the truck supporting footprint. Portable pump/hose is an independent footprint. Failed approaches, depleted medium and later fire_spread remain visible.
S9 shared integration uses existing facility semantics for physical equipment/facilities and G02 placed_humans/pinned_humans for people. No new upstream semantic class is introduced.

The explicit public regional-survey brief contains only map-level search intent. T001/A005 must obtain real local evidence before rescue or hazard tasks are proposed; no casualty or hazard state is seeded into public priors.

display.model_origins declares each new production family origin [0,0,0] in GLB +Y-up metres; state variants share it at unit scale. This preserves authored support contacts and asymmetric equipment without editing source assets.

State display entities are predeclared and selected only from actual equipment, human-carrier, facility-leak and spill-volume truth. Inactive variants retract POSITION; no hidden model is parked away from the incident.

A062 measures actual hose reach to the hazard footprint from its physical equipment origin; the truck must reach a real exterior stand. DEPLOYED is shown during the accepted A062 operation, then BASE after completion/cancellation. The independent pump stays at its actual staged pose; it can only operate within its own 7.24 m hose and 10 m crew reach. Refilling a fixed pump remotely from a distant supply station is not supported.
Hazard sampling is explicitly enabled on this scene’s mobile sensor agents. It uses the existing scripted local A005 range/miss model; SC01/SC03 RGB sensing is unaffected by this extension.

T094 requests six abstract water units per truck refill. A028 consumes only available matching stock item quantities at the actual supply station, possibly across several existing item IDs, and credits only the transferred amount; twelve stock units remain the finite overall limit.
Generated instance presence is not task completion; existing agent capabilities, beliefs, execution, logs and AAS plugin remain authoritative.

Compatibility authority: configs/asset_allocation.json scenes.SC07.rules. Mission provenance records explicit delivered-BASE human substitutions; missing assets are not fetched or credited as delivered variants.
Camera observation settings reuse SC01; task allowlists/capabilities remain scene-specific. Missing generated incident subjects or exact staffed facilities refuse explicitly.
